data.name: Jameela
data.gender_notes: Jameela is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of jamīl, from the Arabic root ج-م-ل (j-m-l), 'to be beautiful'. Its root is ج-م-ل (j-m-l). A common Muslim female name. Jameela is a Arabic name meaning “Beautiful; elegant; lovely”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jameela expresses “Beautiful; elegant; lovely”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of jamīl, from the Arabic root ج-م-ل (j-m-l), 'to be beautiful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jameela total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
